title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 MAR)
summary: A curated collection of feature enhancement requests and improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central submitted by the community, covering areas such as data migration, development capabilities, financial management, inventory, purchasing, sales, and tenant administration.
key_points: Covers diverse functional areas including finance, development, sales, purchasing, inventory, and administration
Includes both bug fixes and new feature requests from community members
Addresses telemetry improvements, API enhancements, and extensibility needs
Proposes UI/UX improvements and localization enhancements

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the context that this is a comprehensive compilation of community-submitted improvement ideas for Business Central
